Reckless. Preventable. Unforgivable.

Reckless. Preventable. Unforgivable.

Conflict flares up again. Dangerous escalation.

If this isn’t quickly contained, the U.S.-Iran war is back on a path toward direct military confrontation, with renewed risks of regional escalation.

Joined @BTnewsroom to discuss the funeral of Ayatollah Khamenei, the mood in Iran, the absence of the new Leader, and why the US-Israel war on Iran failed.

WATCH: piped.video/watch?v=BZluv2h0…

U.S.-Iran peace talks are messy and may fail. But if they produce a deal, it could prove more durable than the JCPOA. Unlike the 2015 agreement, this deal is emerging out of a war, with Republicans on the U.S. side and hardliners on the Iranian side owning the process rather than opposing it.
